messages.text: How do I create a new capability? First time doing this — is there a checklist?

Yep! Open a CAP ticket in Jira, fill the capability manifest, open a city-map PR for ownership/deps, then ping platform for review. Full guide is on DevPortal under Capabilities → Create a Capability.
Also join #capability-help and #platform-oncall. City map approval usually takes 2–3 business days.
Who owns the Payments capability these days?
Payments (payments-v2) is owned by the Money Movement team — lead is alex.chen. Check city map if you need the dependency list.
Capability registration failing with 'missing owner team' — what am I missing?
Your city-map node needs an `owner_team` field. Manifest alone isn't enough — registry syncs from the city map.
